title: cyanus intermedius
intro: Cyanus intermedius, commonly known as Intermediate Cornflower, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. The health benefits of Cyanus intermedius include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Cyanus intermedius include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
